definitions.explanation: a conflict or argument between people, often involving friction or discord

examples.japanese: {揉|も}め{事|ごと}を{避|さ}けたい。
{隣人|りんじん}との{揉|も}め{事|ごと}がある。
examples.english: I have a dispute with my neighbor.

examples.japanese: {遺産相続|いさんそうぞく}の{揉|も}め{事|ごと}で{兄弟|きょうだい}が{疎遠|そえん}になった。
examples.english: The siblings became estranged due to an inheritance dispute.

notes:
FORMATION:
{揉|も}める (to quarrel, to have friction) + {事|ごと} (matter, thing) → a matter of dispute

VERB FORM:
{揉|も}める - to quarrel, to have trouble

RELATED WORDS:
- {諍|いさか}い (quarrel, dispute)
- {喧嘩|けんか} (fight, quarrel)
- {トラブル} (trouble)
- {紛争|ふんそう} (conflict, dispute - more formal/serious)

COLLOCATIONS:
- {揉|も}め{事|ごと}を{起|お}こす (to cause trouble)
- {揉|も}め{事|ごと}に{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる (to get involved in a dispute)
- {揉|も}め{事|ごと}を{収|おさ}める (to settle a dispute)
